subject: evs
verifiedAgainst: NCERT textbook listing (ncert.nic.in/textbook.php) + table of contents in the book prelims PDF
note: Listed by NCERT under the subject "The World Around Us".

topics.title: Water in different forms and places
outcomes: Learner can describe where water is found on Earth (oceans, rivers, ice, vapour) and why fresh water is scarce
misconceptions: Thinks most of Earth’s water can be drunk
hooks: How much of a bucket of Earth’s water is fresh? a spoonful

topics.title: Water for living things
outcomes: Learner can explain how plants and animals depend on water
misconceptions: Believes plants drink water only through leaves
hooks: A plant kept without water for a week

topics.title: From source to sea
outcomes: Learner can trace the path of a river and how it changes the land and lives along it
misconceptions: Thinks rivers start from the sea
hooks: The Godavari from Nashik to the Bay of Bengal

topics.title: Floods and keeping rivers clean
outcomes: Learner can describe causes of floods and river pollution and ways to reduce them
misconceptions: Believes a river cleans itself whatever we throw in
hooks: Why are idols immersed in tanks nowadays?

topics.title: Why food spoils: microbes
outcomes: Learner can explain that tiny living things called microbes spoil food
misconceptions: Thinks food spoils only because it gets old, not because of microbes
Believes all microbes are harmful
hooks: Curd setting overnight vs bread getting fungus

topics.title: Preserving food
outcomes: Learner can describe traditional and modern ways of preserving food
misconceptions: Believes refrigerated food never spoils
hooks: Achaar with salt and oil; sun-dried papads

topics.title: A clean, green and safe school
outcomes: Learner can suggest ways to keep the school clean, green and safe and manage its water and waste
misconceptions: Thinks keeping the school clean is only the sweeper’s job
hooks: A school garden and a compost pit

topics.title: Safety on the way to school
outcomes: Learner can follow road safety rules near the school
misconceptions: Believes it is safe to cross from behind a parked bus
hooks: Traffic signals near your school gate

topics.title: Languages, music and dances of India
outcomes: Learner can describe the diversity of languages, food and art across states
misconceptions: Thinks Hindi is spoken by everyone in India
hooks: How to say "water" in five Indian languages

topics.title: National symbols and the Republic
outcomes: Learner can identify national symbols and explain what they stand for
misconceptions: Believes the national animal is the lion
hooks: Spot the Ashoka emblem on a currency note

topics.title: Islands, forests and ghats
outcomes: Learner can describe special places like the Andaman Islands and the Western Ghats and the life found there
misconceptions: Thinks islands have no forests or animals
hooks: Andaman coral reefs; Western Ghats rains

topics.title: Protecting special places
outcomes: Learner can suggest how tourists and locals can protect fragile places
misconceptions: Believes visiting a place cannot harm it
hooks: No plastic on treks in the Ghats

topics.title: Energy makes things work
outcomes: Learner can identify sources of energy (food, sun, wind, water, fuel, electricity) used to do work
misconceptions: Thinks energy is a substance that can be seen
hooks: What makes a kite fly, a fan spin and you run?

topics.title: Saving energy
outcomes: Learner can suggest ways to save electricity and fuel at home
misconceptions: Believes switching off appliances makes no difference
hooks: Solar panels on roofs; switching off fans when leaving

topics.title: From fibre to fabric
outcomes: Learner can describe how cotton and silk become thread and cloth by spinning and weaving
misconceptions: Thinks all cloth is made in factories
hooks: Charkha and the handloom; Kanchipuram silk

topics.title: Stitching and caring for clothes
outcomes: Learner can practise simple stitches and suggest ways to reuse old clothes
misconceptions: Believes torn clothes must be thrown away
hooks: Turning an old saree into a quilt

topics.title: Day and night
outcomes: Learner can explain day and night using a globe and a torch
misconceptions: Thinks the Sun goes behind the mountains at night
hooks: Why is it night in the USA when it is day in India?

topics.title: Seasons and changes in nature
outcomes: Learner can record seasonal changes in plants, animals and weather
misconceptions: Believes the Earth is closer to the Sun in summer
hooks: Migratory birds arriving at Bharatpur in winter

topics.title: Sharing the Earth with all life
outcomes: Learner can explain why the Earth’s resources are shared by all living things and countries
misconceptions: Thinks pollution in one place does not affect others
hooks: Birds that fly across many countries

topics.title: Caring for the Earth
outcomes: Learner can plan simple actions to protect the environment
misconceptions: Believes one person’s actions do not matter
hooks: A week-long "no plastic" challenge at home
